verdict.rationale: Paddle is a hosted billing and merchant-of-record SaaS, and whether its source is openly licensed is a fair question for this kind of product. The pack only shows an OpenAPI spec kept in a GitHub repo and official SDKs, with no license stated for either. An API specification is not the product's source code, so this is adjacent at most and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
